system.description:
You can use this incantation to create powerful gusts of wind within a confined space or a gentle breeze over an area up to 100 ft. across. The gusts are strong enough to send light-weight objects soaring, but not strong enough to knock people off their feet.

While focusing, you can sustain this magic for up to 1 minute. Each spark either doubles the strength of the wind or the duration of the effects.
